payload.core_composition_summary: Sort points to create sparse graph with O(m) edges, then run Dijkstra with priority queue for shortest path.
payload.rationale: Sorting reduces edge count from O(m^2) to O(m); Dijkstra computes answer; heap enables fast min extraction.
